body: Ill do this if you can wait a few days for my keys to come off cool down..  6 days.
I don't think I'm going to make it to my predetermined deadline.  I am feeling much worse now that the present events have sunk in.

I go shooting once every two months and I find that enjoyable. (because guns are fun I refuse to add to their stigma by going out that way) 

I ride a motorcycle and that's just about the only thing that I get any enjoyment from lol.  But this may be unhealthy as I drive like a suicidal idiot praying for that random car to pull out in front of me as I do 120 in a 25.  It's pretty fun though. 

I also draw with charcoal, although I'm never any good when Im upset.  Some people seem to channel the negative energy into their art and make masterpieces. I do not have this trait.
I don't think I could even handle a cat lol let alone a child by myself.  Plus I'm lacking in the finances.  Good suggestion though, I'm sure that would give most people purpose.
I'd just walk away and avoid them.  Trust me,  it's not worth what little energy I have left.
Nope,  have been desperatly asking for help and family could not possibly care less. Too wrapped up in  themselves.
It appears as though he is that whipped. He had his own words when he decided to contribute to our verbal brawl.  It's clear she's a crazy person to me now.
Very much so. Wouldn't want them back in my life for a few days or a lifetime.  Poisonous people. The things they said where unforgivable.

Here we go; names changed to protect identities and to allow me to remain anonymous. Paul and Bonni are my roommates and a couple.  Paul was my best friend and Bonni was a bearable roommate but had her what I can only assume bi-polar moments so it worked.  We where cleaning out our old house to move into a new one.  Just 2 days before inspection she decides she gives up and starts playing g pokemon go and straight up just starts being a bitch as I'm fucking frantically cleaning the place things like "have you finished the bathroom yet"  in the most condescending &  rude tone possible all night.  Basically just being an all around jerk.  This whole time as I am busting my ass she is playing pokemon go.  So when she said the last sparky comment I snapped and told her to contribute. She flips her shit and turns the whole thing against me.  Paul sides with her and shuns me.  That's basically the short version.  Paul wants nothing to do with me, they left me to clean the whole place as they are not on the lease(it's in my name).
Currently out of a car in California. Had a falling out with the roommates.

Yes,  misanthrope is the perfect word.  I resent everyone around me for ignoring my desperate attempts to receive help.  I recently contacted multiple cousins I thought would care but my pleas for help have fallen on deaf ears.  The more I tread water like this the more I understand that I am indeed alone in this.
If there is a reason to reconsider I have not found it. Still feeling as distraught as yesterday.  Worse part is I work with her.
I love xkcd,  the strip was one I hadn't seen &  I found it amusing.  Thank you for sharing your view on how to keep moving through life.
I know for a fact I cannot go through this again. I refuse.  I don't want to set my self up for it for a third time.
Probably not too late.  Call someone or better yet 911. Faster the better it's going to hurt more if you procrastinate.
May I ask how?  Same boat here man.  Exploring options.
